title: Two catalogs in one Go process

scenes.heading: Two teams have different catalogs
voice: Two teams share a Go service for GPU recipes.
Each expects the settings from its own catalog.

scenes.heading: Bind each client to its source
scenes.sub: Select the recipe provider at construction
voice: Create a client for each catalog.
Research can layer filesystem overrides on the built-in recipes, while production uses a client pointed at its own catalog.

scenes.heading: Pin the production catalog
voice: Use a full manifest digest to select the production catalog from an OCI registry.
AICR checks the downloaded content before using it to resolve any recipe for that client.

scenes.heading: Resolve the same target twice
scenes.sub: Route the request to the selected client
scenes.result: Each team gets its catalog’s result
voice: Now resolve the same GPU and workload criteria in each client.
The platform can return the team-specific result because each request goes through its configured catalog.

payoff: Two clients resolve the same target against their configured catalogs, with an immutable OCI digest for production.
